proof:
classical
refine ⟨h_T012.1, h_T013, h_T015, ?_⟩
intro b hb hb0 hspan
letI : Module.IsTorsionFree (R p) ℂ := by
  apply (Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective).2
  change Function.Injective ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (scalarRing p).subtype)
  exact (algebraMap ℚ ℂ).injective.comp Subtype.val_injective
let e : R p ≃ₗ[R p] J p M (ev y v 0) :=
  (LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton (R p) ℂ b hb0).trans
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hspan.symm)
have he (r : R p) : (e r : ℂ) = r • b := rfl
rcases h_T011.2.1 with ⟨s, hs⟩
let E : (Ix l → R p) ≃ₗ[R p] L p M :=
  (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : Ix l => e)).trans s
refine ⟨(Pi.basisFun (R p) (Ix l)).map E, ?_⟩
intro i
rw [Module.Basis.map_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply]
change (s (fun j : Ix l => e ((Pi.single i (1 : R p) : Ix l → R p) j)) : V) = b • ev y v i.val
rw [hs]
simp [he, Pi.single_apply, ite_smul]
